question: Which flying unit from 1 tier building in BAR can shoot and stun enemy targets?

5.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the vanilla WC3 building chain the only tier-1/secondary flying shooter that has a true stun is the Human Gryphon Rider.

The Rider is trained at the Gryphon Aviary, the Aviary is the first tier/secondary building off the Human Barracks, so it is normally spoken of as a tier-1 production building. The Gryphon Rider is a ranged flying unit and its active ability Gryphon Stomp is a ground-targeted stun, 2-3 s stun on enemy ground units, on top of its normal ranged attack.

That is the Human equivalent. The Orc tier-1 flying shooter with a crowd-control feel is the Harpy from the Harpy Hatchery, the first tier/secondary Orc flying production building off the Great Hall. The Harpy is a ranged flyer and its attack is the classic “shoot-and-CC” harpy, i.e. the Orc counterpart to the Human Gryphon Rider.

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the classic WC3 tech tree the only Tier-1 flying ranged unit is the Night Elf Hippogryph Rider.

It is trained from the Night Elf Tier-1 production structure, the Moon Well / Lumber Mill line, i.e. the first tier of the Night Elf economy. The Hippogryph Rider is a flying, ranged unit that is produced at Tier-1 and is the Night Elf’s first air option. It is the unit that is normally quoted as the “Tier-1 flyer that shoots”, and in the common shorthand of the map it is the one that is paired with the stun-type control play of the Night Elf Tier-1 opening.

That is the Night Elf air unit that comes off a Tier-1 building in the BAR/WC3 setting.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the WC3-based BAR tiering the Tier-1 Aviary flying line is the one that does that.

The Night Elf/Human Aviary Tier-1 flyer is the Hippogryph / Gryphon Rider that is trained from the Aviary / Griffon Aviary. 

It is a ranged flying unit and it comes with the Stomp line. Gryphon Stomp / Hippogryph Stomp is an AOE ground stomp that is used on attack and stuns the targets it hits for a short period while the unit is still doing its normal ranged harass. That is the only Tier-1 Aviary flyer in the BAR tech tree that is both a shooter and a stunner. 

In the Human naming used by a lot of BAR write-ups the same unit is referred to as the Gryphon Rider from the Tier-1 Griffon Aviary.

3.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the BAR/Warcraft III / Age of Mythology tier nomenclature the only tier-1
aviary/temple flying shooter that comes with a built in stun is the Harpy line.

In WC3 terms that is the Human Dragonhawk Rider / the Night Elf Harpy that is
produced out of the tier-1 Aviary / Tree of Life / Temple. It is a true flying
ranged unit and its rider ability, Ankle Breaker / Screech, is the short
stun/attack-speed debuff that is used on the target after the ranged attack
lands. 

In Age of Mythology parlance the same slot is the Hellenic Harpy trained at
the Classical Age Temple. It is the tier-1 flying myth unit that shoots a
ranged attack and applies the Screech stun. That is the unit people normally
refer to as the tier-1 flying stun shooter.

The other T1 air units are mostly scout/fighter/damage roles, making Thunderbird the one that fits the “shoot and stun” description.
